title: CUB K2 task-aware gradient subset coverage screen
research_question: Can task-aware pair selection exploit complementarity at K2 to improve recognition benefit or class safety relative to random K2 annotation?

fold_task_head.architecture: linear 2048-to-200 softmax head on L2-normalized frozen features

strategies.FEATURE_FACILITY: exact per-class pair maximizing mean nearest-selected cosine similarity in frozen image-feature space
strategies.GRADIENT_FACILITY: exact per-class pair maximizing mean nearest-selected cosine similarity in implicit classification-gradient space; gradient cosine is the product of feature cosine and softmax-error cosine

training.model: frozen PAT-D-260728-001 ResNet-50 layer4-adapted PrPool stack

screening_gate.ranking: benefit passers first by BA descending, negative-transfer rate ascending, worst-class harm descending; otherwise safety passers by negative-transfer rate ascending then BA descending
screening_gate.on_pass: run a newly frozen paired multi-seed confirmation, then CCT20+
screening_gate.on_no_pass: stop the active-selector direction; do not unlock CCT confirmation or final test
